blocks.text: For the fifth consecutive year, a creative residency grant is being offered with the support of the Ministry of Culture / DRAC Normandy by ‘Les femmes s’exposent’ festival to professional female photographers residing in France:
RESIDENCY in Houlgate, Normandy: a grant of €6,000 to carry out a photographic project on the town of Houlgate and its surroundings.
Applications must be submitted in accordance with the specified procedures by 15 November 2026, before 11.55 pm. Any incomplete applications will not be considered.
